svg.title: Three excavations of the materials literature
svg.desc: Section drawings of three text-mining pipelines with exact counts at each stage and the error audits each team published.
svg.text: Three excavations of the materials literature, each with its losses counted
Facts printed in methods sections were moved into searchable records. Each team published how much its pipeline kept and how
often it agreed with the text. None of the three repeated a synthesis or measured a new sample.
MOF structures in the Cambridge Structural
pairings of a MOF name with a property
A name and at least one property are now held for
About one extracted pairing in four is wrong. The
parsers favored precision over recall and missed
much of what the papers contain.
Route words found in the text
Solvothermal is the usual laboratory route; many
papers name the solvents and never use the word.
A compound labeled only "1" or "2" could not be tied
to any property. Some articles could not be
accessed, and some were not in English.
judged to be about inorganic synthesis
codified recipes, each with a balanced equation
30 lacked a complete set of starting materials and
42 of the other 70 the pipeline failed to rebuild

Sources: Glasby et al. 2023, DigiMOF, Chemistry of Materials; Kononova et al. 2019, Scientific Data; Court and Cole 2020, npj Computational
Materials. Layer widths are drawn on a logarithmic scale of the count; units differ between layers (structures, papers, paragraphs, records).
